title: benchmarkDefinition
responsibility: Pins a benchmark to committed source, validates its contract and checks configured runner availability.

inputs.name: prepareBenchmark.path
inputs.description: Path to the trusted benchmark definition JSON file.

inputs.name: prepareBenchmark.runners
inputs.description: Codex and Claude runner implementations used to preflight the named candidates.

outputs.name: benchmarkRunners
outputs.description: Native Codex and Claude adapters keyed by their configured runner names.

outputs.name: prepareBenchmark
outputs.description: Normalized definition, pinned source revision, fingerprint, runner versions and trial count.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects invalid definitions, non-root projects, unresolved revisions or unavailable runners.
